This module implements:
1. A core LRU cache with TTL (time-to-live) expiry functionality.
2. A thread-safe wrapper around the cache for concurrent access.
3. A complete pytest test suite covering all edge cases.

The LRU cache uses a doubly-linked list with O(1) operations and a dictionary
for O(1) lookups. TTL expiry is handled lazily on access and periodically via
a background cleaner thread.

Author: Assistant

    """Strategies for handling eviction events."""
    LOG = "log"
    CALLBACK = "callback"
    IGNORE = "ignore"

    """Modes for TTL expiry handling."""
    LAZY = "lazy"

    """Raised when a TTL expired entry is accessed."""
